description: Source code for a module defining classes and methods related to a dashboard/board feature in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including view creation, updates, and related data models.

classes.name: board_board
classes.description: Represents a dashboard with lines/actions and view management.

classes.name: board_line
classes.description: Represents individual action lines within a dashboard.

classes.name: board_note_type
classes.description: Defines types of notes that can be associated with the board.

classes.name: board_note
classes.description: Represents notes or comments associated with the board.

methods.name: create_view
methods.description: Generates XML view architecture for the dashboard based on its lines.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides write method to update the view architecture after changes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new dashboard and its associated view.

methods.name: fields_view_get
methods.description: Retrieves and possibly customizes the view architecture.
